Brand

ayrloom in NYC

Ayrloom is the most widely stocked cannabis brand in New York City. It is carried at 63 of the 68 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 1,300 products on shelves, more than any other label. The brand comes from the family behind the Beak & Skiff apple orchard in central New York, which explains the line: cider-style drinks, gummies and a long list of 2:1 and 1:1 THC-to-CBD beverages in flavors like Honeycrisp, cranberry apple, lemonade, root beer and vanilla cola.

Edibles are the core at 571 listings, mostly drinks and gummies, followed by 366 vapes, 142 pre-rolls, 136 tinctures and 96 topicals. That tincture and topical depth is why Ayrloom tops both of those categories citywide. Prices start at $3.39, and the single-serve 10-milligram drinks cost only a few dollars at most shops, which makes them the most common entry-level item on New York menus. Deep Ayrloom runs are at NY Canna Co in Midtown, Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay with 40 products and The Flowery Upper West Side with 49.

ayrloom FAQ
What does 2:1 mean on Ayrloom drinks?

Two parts THC to one part CBD, usually 10 milligrams THC and 5 milligrams CBD per can. The CBD softens the effect, which is why these are a common first purchase. Ayrloom also makes 1:1 versions at 5 milligrams THC.

Is Ayrloom a New York brand?

Yes. It is grown and made in New York by the family behind the Beak & Skiff orchard near Syracuse. Licensed New York dispensaries can only sell cannabis grown and processed in the state, so every Ayrloom product on a New York shelf is made here.

Where can I find the most Ayrloom products?

NY Canna Co on 5th Avenue in Midtown, Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay (40 products) and The Flowery Upper West Side (49) carry deep runs. Almost every licensed shop carries at least the drinks.
